choice.basis: The May bar is an extreme outlier low relative to every other displayed month (visually ~8,000 kWh, less than half the next-lowest Jun bar at ~17,500 and a small fraction of the 40,000 peak). This isolated, severe low-output status is the basis for classifying May as a critical anomaly rather than a standard low-output case.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review
